descriptions.text: Enchanted Xistera Extension Slot. Head-throwing attachment. This is a unique item! This item was created especially for Crawler Carl by The Open Intellect Pacifist Action Network, Intergalactic NFC. Attaches to the end of a xistera. Allows for the tossing of a head. This special edition head tosser is custom made to fit decapitated love doll heads. When tossing a head of a withering spirit, the distance traveled will be greatly enhanced. (500 meters x Strength.) Tossed head will be magically returned once the extension slot is removed from xistera.

beats.headline: Fifty kilometres of Samantha
beats.text: An Emergency Platinum Benefactor Box arrives from the Pacifist Action Network as a feral demon, Slit, comes for Samantha with a crackling whip. Carl shoves Samantha face-first into the extension's round slot. She fits perfectly. He turns ninety degrees and chucks her with all his might, well over a hundred strength with his gear: over fifty kilometres. Slit turns to follow. Once Slit is gone, he pulls the extension off and into his inventory, and Samantha pops into existence at his feet, screaming that it was her kill. Taking it out again, he runs a finger over the wicker-like stuff and its tiny inscription: made for Crawler Carl, with design approval by the network's president of Outreach Operations.

beats.headline: Two rockets and a ping
beats.text: Two missiles duct-taped to her head, Samantha lies face down in the installed extension. Carl drinks a levitation potion, then Major Charlie for thirty seconds of extra intelligence, rises up through the green cloud and pings: two hunters in a clearing a kilometre and a half northeast of town. Go get 'em. He lobs her at them, the rockets flare over the clearing, and she disappears into the trees to a distant detonation. Bring me back, she messages. He drops the extension and she pops up at his feet, hair on fire, with the ankle of the second, unconscious elf clamped in her teeth.

beats.headline: Recalled from the river
beats.text: Carl loaded Samantha into the extension with an alarm ball taped to her head and threw her upstream, to shout when it went off and aim for the castle. The extension has stayed on his arm since. Now Miss Nadine breaks for the water, and he has to take it off before he dives in. Samantha, I gotta teleport you back. No, she messages, I almost have him. He pulls the extension into his inventory.

beats.headline: Everything comes back
beats.text: The plan was for Samantha to roll up to Sister Ines and bite onto her; Carl would drop the extension and summon them both, and a card battle would follow. That is not what happens. When he drops the xistera extension, everything lands around him and Donut in about a quarter of a mile each way: Samantha, Sister Ines, the massive snake she rides, around a thousand zombie baby seals, five thousand zombie crabs, five hundred zombie adult seals, a great many living ones, what seems like every fish in the world, and an alarming number of corpses.

beats.headline: A few feet
beats.text: Entering Havana, Carl teleports onto a spider automaton and crushes it; the other three scatter. Samantha kept her word, for once, and the fourth spider is still inside her. He unsummons the xistera extension still at the end of his hand, and she blinks and reappears right next to him, teleported only a few feet. A bolt of lightning crashes out through the capitol's front door.

beats.headline: Back from the volcano
beats.text: Carl fired Samantha up and out of Larracos to Emberus in the volcano, telling her he cannot bring her back while the god is touching her. Now she messages: he's not touching me anymore, bring me back. Carl drops the xistera, and Samantha clunks to the ground, heavy and smoking. If he thought she had been burned before, this is ten times worse. He barely recognizes her.
